Container.Name: Honcho-Dashboard
Container.Overview:
Honcho Dashboard is a self-hosted operator dashboard for Plastic Labs' Honcho memory service. It provides full observability into workspaces, sessions, memory reasoning queues, peer cards, and derived conclusions with a clean dark terminal UI.
[b]Requirements:[/b] A running instance of Honcho API (e.g. honcho-aio or the distributed Honcho stack). If using container hostnames (like http://honcho-aio:8000), make sure both containers share a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the dashboard web interface (container listens on 3000 internally). Default is 3002 to avoid collision with other web services on 3000.

Config.Name: Honcho Proxy Base URL
Config.Description: Server-side default upstream Honcho API URL. The dashboard proxies calls to this endpoint (e.g. http://honcho-aio:8000 or http://192.168.1.x:8000).

Config.Name: Client Honcho Base URL
Config.Description: Upstream Honcho server API URL for client-side queries.

Config.Name: Proxy Allowed Bases
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowlist of upstream Honcho origins the server-side proxy will forward to. Must match or include HONCHO_PROXY_BASE_URL.

Config.Name: Honcho API Bearer Token
Config.Description: (Optional) Bearer token if your Honcho server has authentication enabled (AUTH_USE_AUTH=true). Leave empty if auth is disabled.

Config.Name: Operator Database URL
Config.Description: (Optional) Read-only Postgres DSN to the SAME database Honcho uses (e.g. postgresql+psycopg://postgres:secret@honcho-aio:5432/honcho). Enables throughput charts, 52-week heatmap, db size / vector-count / top-tables, and PostgreSQL diagnostics.

Config.Name: Honcho Log File Mount
Config.Description: (Optional) Host path to Honcho's log file (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/honcho-aio/logs/honcho.log). Mounts read-only into the container to enable the log tail panel on Diagnostics.

Config.Name: Honcho Log File Container Path
Config.Description: Path inside container matching the target of the log mount above. Default: /honcho.log.

Config.Name: Honcho Runtime Start Timestamp
Config.Description: (Optional) ISO-8601 timestamp of when your Honcho process started to report Honcho uptime alongside dashboard uptime.

Config.Name: Operator Config Keys
Config.Description: (Optional) Comma-separated extra env keys to expose on /api/operator/config. Secrets matching token/secret/password/key are auto-redacted.
